t: Napoleon's alliance turned the Electorate of Bavaria into a kingdom in 1806, the second largest German state.
Montgelas built a centralised, tolerant administration, and the constitution of 1818 created one of Germany's first parliaments.
Ludwig I and Ludwig II made Munich and the Bavarian Alps famous for art, architecture and fantasy castles.
dyk: The Oktoberfest began in October 1810 as a public celebration of the wedding of Crown Prince Ludwig, the future Ludwig I, to Princess Therese of Saxe-Hildburghausen.
ev: Maximilian IV Joseph is proclaimed King Maximilian I Joseph of Bavaria
The Treaty of Ried brings Bavaria over to the Allies
The constitution of 26 May creates a two-chamber parliament
Germany's first railway opens between Nuremberg and Fürth
Ludwig I abdicates after the Lola Montez affair and revolution
Bavaria joins the German Empire with extensive reserved rights
Ludwig II is declared unfit to rule and dies in Lake Starnberg
Kurt Eisner proclaims a republic in Munich and Ludwig III flees
